t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Spot patterns in which colour gnomes leads you to the most mushrooms.  They found that for them choosing the Yellow Red and Blue Gnomes lead to the highest numbers.

vb_textbox.text: Be quick choosing your gnome and clicking to collect the mushrooms so that you do not miss any chances to get points.  Try to spot patterns.  I found purple, Pink and green to be giving me good numbers but that might differ for you.
